rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a material letter template: acknowledge receipt of a committee's final report, praise the committee's accomplishments and contribution to a national objective, identify its experience or work as useful going forward, and close by extending appreciation to the committee's members. C12 is closely connected to the same committee and supplies its substantive purpose, but its appointment-and-organization structure is less like the child. C01 shares the report-acknowledgment form but lacks the child's closure, succession, and member-thanks sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This acknowledges the receipt of the report of the Joint Federal-State Action Committee
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I received the final Report of your Committee with pleasure and appreciation
shared_material.explanation: Both open by acknowledging receipt of a committee report.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Committee has worked well and earnestly toward the strengthening of our governmental system.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: was gratified to note the Committee's many accomplishments in stimulating action on a broad front to meet the Nation's scientific and technological manpower problems
shared_material.explanation: Both immediately commend the committee's work and connect it to a broader national objective.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is my hope and expectation that the Advisory Commission will further the Committee's work
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The experience of the Committee will certainly be a useful guide in this regard
shared_material.explanation: Both describe the completed committee's work or experience as a basis for continued efforts.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I extend my thanks to the members ... and to the joint staffs, for their work and interest in this project.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I extend my warm good wishes and ask that you express to the members of the Committee my sincere appreciation for their fine cooperation and effort.
shared_material.explanation: The closing appreciation for the committee's members and their efforts is closely parallel in language and function.
